name: Hotel St. George Helsinki
insider_take: This Art Nouveau masterpiece has been Helsinki's most prestigious address since 1930, where diplomats and celebrities have made history in its elegant halls.
whats_special: Hotel St. George occupies a stunning 1930s Art Nouveau building that once housed the Finnish Literature Society. The hotel seamlessly blends original architectural details like terrazzo floors and brass fixtures with contemporary Scandinavian design. Its rooftop bar offers panoramic views over Helsinki's Senate Square and harbor.
pro_tip: Book a table at the rooftop restaurant during summer's white nights - you'll enjoy nearly 24 hours of daylight with breathtaking views of the Baltic Sea and Suomenlinna fortress.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you steps from Helsinki Cathedral and Market Square. Take the short ferry ride to UNESCO-listed Suomenlinna Sea Fortress, or explore the trendy Design District just around the corner, home to Finnish design studios and the famous Marimekko flagship store.
pros: Prime location in Helsinki's design district with easy access to attractions
Exceptional Nordic design and contemporary luxury throughout the property
Outstanding dining venues including rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar
Comprehensive wellness facilities with spa, gym, and indoor pool
cons: Urban location may experience city noise
